description: This script is a test file for measuring pack performance using bitmaps in Git. It sets up environment configurations, creates tags, and runs performance tests related to bitmap lookup tables.

methods.name: test_lookup_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Sets up and runs a performance test for Git pack bitmaps with a toggle parameter, configuring Git to use bitmap settings and creating necessary tags.

calls: git tag --message="tag pointing to HEAD" perf-tag HEAD
